Is Dany Boon signing with us?
Yes, he accepted our offer.
That is very good news, thank you.
You do not seem very thrilled.
I am tired from these negotiations.
Are you never ashamed of manipulating?
Ashamed of what? Of getting contracts?
Of manipulating all our artist friends?
It is our job, we chose it.
This profession destroys our good friendships.
Business demands toughness.
I will send you signed contracts tomorrow.
All right, good evening to you, Elise.

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to accept, to agree'.

examples.text: Gabriel, tu as l'air satisfait de toi.
examples.trans: Gabriel, you look pleased with yourself.

meanings.note: avoir l'air + adjective = to look, to seem

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: aller + infinitive: tu vas l'agacer = you're going to annoy her
ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Oui, allô? Ça fait des mois que j'attends ton appel!
examples.trans: Yes, hello? I've been waiting for your call for months!
Pass along my regards to her.

examples.text: J'en suis ravi. Transmets-lui mes amitiés.
examples.trans: I am delighted. Pass along my warm regards to her.

meanings.note: un grand artiste = a great artist

examples.text: Je travaille avec des artistes photographes.
Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: avoir peur = to be afraid, avoir raison = to be right, avoir 40 ans = to be 40
elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Tu n'aimais pas Mandelieu? C'est un bel endroit.
examples.trans: Didn't you like Mandelieu? It's a lovely place.

meanings.note: before the noun; bel before a vowel: un bel endroit
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...
as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: We went back to my place.
Really work on it at home.

examples.text: Entre un donneur anonyme et un ami, je choisis l'ami.
examples.trans: Between an anonymous donor and a friend, I choose the friend.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Core French verb meaning 'to choose'.

examples.text: Je ne connais rien aux contrats.
examples.trans: I don't know anything about contracts.

meanings.note: signer un contrat = to sign a contract

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.note: je n'ai pas de temps; also before a plural adjective: de mauvaises nouvelles

examples.text: Si vous avez besoin d'aide, demandez.
examples.trans: If you need help, just ask.

meanings.note: Feminine abstract noun formed with '-ité' (from Latin '-itas', English '-ity'). Standard feminine noun meaning 'hardness, toughness'.

examples.text: Les affaires demandent de la dureté.
Elle montre la dureté de cette époque.
examples.trans: It shows the harshness of that era.

examples.text: Ils détruisent trois ans de mon travail!
examples.trans: They destroy three years of my work!

examples.text: Le feu a détruit la maison.
Un scénario est fait pour être détruit!
examples.trans: A script is made to be destroyed!

examples.text: Oui, c'est envoyé. Voici la facture.
examples.trans: Yes, it's been sent. Here's the bill.

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to send'.
pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: Bien sûr que tu es fatiguée.
Je ne supporte plus la honte de ne pas savoir nager.
examples.trans: I cannot take the shame of not knowing how to swim anymore.

meanings.note: avoir honte de = to be ashamed of
for masculine nouns, and in impersonal phrases: il y a

examples.text: Je ne suis jamais en retard.
Gabriel! Je suis à mon cours d'équitation.
examples.trans: Gabriel! I'm at my horse-riding lesson.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: C'est Mathias. Il manipule tout le monde.

meanings.note: First-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are'), the most productive verb class in French. Core French verb meaning 'to manipulate'.
merci beaucoup = thank you very much

examples.trans: What do you do for a living?

examples.text: Sans toi, je crois que j'arrêterais ce métier.
examples.trans: Without you, I think I'd quit this job.

meanings.note: Standard masculine noun meaning 'job, trade, profession'.
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.text: Je vais faire traîner les négociations.
examples.trans: I will drag out the negotiations.

examples.text: Consultez vos courriels pour notre négociation.
examples.trans: Check your emails for our negotiation.

examples.text: Je suis fatigué par ces négociations.
examples.trans: I am tired from these negotiations.

examples.text: Et celle qui ne l'obtient pas va nous détester.
examples.trans: And the one who doesn't get it will hate us.

meanings.note: a part, a permit, a result

examples.text: C'est une offre? Je suis touché.
examples.trans: Is that an offer? I'm touched.

meanings.note: faire une offre = to make an offer

examples.text: Oui, oui. J'ai juste besoin d'un petit cours.
examples.trans: Yes, yes. I just need a little lesson.

examples.text: Par exemple, le contrat de Canet.
Je peux regarder un contrat de Mathias? Celui de Canet, par exemple?
examples.trans: Can I look at one of Mathias's contracts? Canet's, for example?

meanings.note: passer par là: to go by there

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

meanings.note: alone, in surprise or when you didn't hear; a bit blunt

examples.text: Je veux vous dire combien je suis ravie d'être avec vous ce soir.
examples.trans: I want to tell you how delighted I am to be with you tonight.

examples.text: Rien n'est signé. On attend l'appel.
examples.trans: Nothing is signed. We're waiting for the call.

meanings.note: a contract, a document; signer avec une agence = join an agency
rien n'est signé = nothing is signed
bonne soirée = have a nice evening

examples.text: Je voulais te faire la surprise.

meanings.note: before the verb; t' before a vowel
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone

examples.text: Très bien. Et vous? Un thé?

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
